editorial:
Imagine waking up one day and deciding that your boss is just too mean to keep around. That is exactly what happens when a group of farm animals decides to kick their human owner out of the house. You get to follow a group of hopeful pigs and hardworking horses who believe they can build a world where everyone is equal and happy. It starts off feeling like a hopeful adventure, but you will quickly see things start to slide. The pigs take charge, and while they promise fairness, they slowly start acting just like the humans they hated. It is a wild ride that shows how power can change a person, or in this case, a pig.

What really hits home is how the characters change over time. The animation is old-school and charming, and the pacing keeps you interested even when things get dark. While some parts might feel a bit slow, the payoff is totally worth it. You should definitely check this out if you like stories about politics or how groups work.
endingExplained: In the end, the pigs completely betray the other animals. They start walking on two legs, wearing clothes, and drinking alcohol. The big twist happens when the animals look through the window and see the pigs having dinner with humans. You realize that the pigs have become exactly like the cruel farmers they replaced. There is no way to tell the difference between the two anymore, and the dream of equality is totally dead.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves stories about power and betrayal.
